description: GX-22 (B-18, D-070): most commits a gated head may be behind the current base tip. merge-phase re-gates a head beyond it (or behind with overlapping changes, merge.regate_on_overlap); with merge.tier1_requires_base_merge off it is also the commit-check limit for a head that carries no merge of the base. Shown as "N behind, limit M".
